## Kimachas Emmah

**Data Manager \| Malaria Research \| Public Health Data**

I work on malaria surveillance systems, monitoring and evaluation, and research data management in Kenya.

My work supports malaria research programs and health systems strengthening through data collection systems, analysis, and reporting.

### Research Interests

-   Malaria surveillance systems\
-   Seasonal Malaria Chemoprevention (SMC)\
-   Public health data systems\
-   Monitoring and evaluation\
-   Research data management
